reader_summary.headline: I’m Zack Fuss, and today we are breaking down Twitter, a business that needs little introduction.
reader_summary.overview: I’m Zack Fuss, and today we are breaking down Twitter, a business that needs little introduction. Founded by Jack Dorsey in 2006, Twitter has become one of the most visited and influential platforms in the world. Yet, despite its rising social status, investors and users have been left frustrated by the company’s pace of innovation and shareholder returns.

key_points.text: To help me break down Twitter’s business, I’m joined by anonymous professional investor, @Compound248.
Please enjoy this breakdown of Twitter.
